purpose: Single source of truth for the whole site. Paste this file into Appearance -> Master Content and press 'Apply master content' to configure theme options, pages, menus, product categories and products in one step.
how_to_import: 1. In wp-admin go to Appearance -> Master Content.
2. Press 'Reload bundled file' to load master-form.json (or paste your own JSON).
3. Choose the scope (everything / theme options only / content only) and press Apply.
4. Open a page in wp-admin with an edit link from the importer report and check the result.
Re-running the import is safe: pages are matched by slug, menu items by target, categories by slug and products by SKU.

field_reference.settings: Flat map of theme option keys. Keys must exist in techjossecom_defaults(): keys starting with show_/enable_ are booleans, *_limit are numbers, *_image accept an attachment ID or a remote image URL (downloaded into the media library), *_url and social_* are URLs, *_color are hex colours.
field_reference.content.categories: Product categories. List parents before children. Optional keys: slug, parent, description, image.
field_reference.content.pages: Pages matched by slug (created or updated). Optional keys: title, content, parent, template, front_page (bool), posts_page (bool), status.
field_reference.content.menu: Menu object or list of menu objects: name, locations (theme locations: primary, topbar, footer_1, footer_2, footer_3, mobile), items (page slug | product_cat slug | url, plus optional title).
field_reference.content.products: Simple products matched by SKU. Keys: name, sku, regular_price, sale_price, description, short_description, categories (slugs), image, gallery, stock_status, stock_quantity, featured, status.

bilingual_examples.note: Customer-facing labels can be English or Bengali. Copy these values into the matching settings keys to switch a string to Bengali.
bilingual_examples.cod_success_message: ধন্যবাদ! আপনার অর্ডারটি গ্রহণ করা হয়েছে। আমাদের প্রতিনিধি শীঘ্রই কল করবেন।
bilingual_examples.filter_note: Any key that is not listed in techjossecom_defaults() is rejected with a warning, so the importer can never write unexpected options.

pages.title: About Us
pages.content:
Who we are

We are an online shop serving customers all over Bangladesh. Every order can be paid in cash when the courier hands over the parcel, so you can shop with total confidence.

Why customers choose us

  • Genuine, verified products
  • Fast nationwide delivery
  • Cash on delivery on every item
  • Friendly support on phone, WhatsApp and Messenger

pages.title: Contact Us
pages.content:
Talk to us

Call or message us any day between 9:00 and 22:00. Our team replies to WhatsApp and Messenger messages within minutes.

  • Hotline: your number here
  • Email: your email here
  • Address: your shop address here

Order tracking

After placing an order you will receive a confirmation call and an SMS with the courier details.

pages.title: Delivery & Return Policy
pages.content:
Delivery

Inside Dhaka: 1-2 working days. Outside Dhaka: 2-4 working days. Delivery charges are shown in the Cash on Delivery popup before you confirm the order.

Return

If a product arrives damaged or is not what you ordered, contact us within 7 days of delivery and we will replace it or refund the amount.

pages.title: Privacy Policy
pages.content:
What we collect

When you place an order we store your name, mobile number and delivery address so the courier can reach you. We never sell or share this information with third parties.

Cookies

Our shop uses cookies to keep your cart contents available between pages.
